new_results: Exact three-chain forward/backward lattice-path recurrence: pair-order probabilities and chain-gap probabilities are sums of F*G edge fluxes, retaining every induced multiplicity.

Cover two-witness theorem: for x lessdot y and b incomparable with both, if the external distinguisher union (D(x,b) minus {y}) union (D(y,b) minus {x}) has size at most one, then one endpoint pair is balanced. Therefore every strong cover flip in a hypothetical counterexample forces at least two distinct external witnesses.

Sharp width-three five-point example with E=25 has Pr(x<b)=18/25, Pr(y<b)=7/25, cover-gap mass 11/25 and exactly two external witnesses, refuting the shortcut that heavy cover flux is impossible or forces three witnesses.
